about_the_game:
WELCOME HARPER

The embodiment of innocence, wrapped in a dangerously sexy angel costume! Her delicate white wings flutter with every move, and that lacy lingerie clings to every flawless curve — from her full hips to her firm, tempting chest. With an innocent smile and a halo that sways with every step, Harper will lure you straight to paradise... or rather, her bed.

But don't be fooled by angelic charm — Harper's fantasies are anything but pure. Roleplay, strap-ons, cuffs, silky ropes... her toy chest is the stuff of sinful dreams. She loves being worshipped... just as much as she enjoys hearing you beg. Add this tempting angel to your collection, and she just might let you taste the forbidden fruit!


WHAT YOU'RE GETTING

Purchasing this DLC unlocks Harper in her Innocent Angel outfit. You can change your mascot anytime by opening your profile and selecting the "Mascot" tab.

Along with the mascot, you'll also receive 5000 Credits and 150 Super Serum.

But most importantly, you'll have our heartfelt thanks! We truly appreciate your support and hope you enjoy this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
